source_commit_mapping.message: docs: design independent code-first video engine

durable_queue_notes: Until P0-05 establishes SQLite WAL state ledger (.agy/state.sqlite), no safe durable queue exists in repository. This static machine-readable backlog snapshot acts as the bootstrap task ledger.

tasks.description: Đọc đủ docs, required-file/link check, ghi base commit, import backlog với status ready/blocked đúng dependencies; không tự tạo app trước scope review

Review exact HyperFrames/Chromium automation/FFmpeg/font artifacts: commit/version/integrity, install scripts, SBOM/license/NOTICE, vulnerabilities. Ghi allowed/blocked usage; chưa source-reviewed không install/run
Rights manifest cho assets/fonts/audio của 3 fixtures; tự tạo hoặc quyền thương mại rõ, hashes/source/license, không lấy demo upstream thiếu quyền
Contract/threat-model review: chốt starter limits, transitions, tenant entities, errors, lease/cancel/idempotency; mở issues cụ thể cho ambiguity, sửa docs cùng quyết định
Thiết lập task ledger/worktree policy/evidence template theo AGENTS, thử recovery bằng synthetic task state; credentials không vào queue/log
